Bug_Title: MS: May expose internal static state by creating a buffer which stores an external array into a static field (EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_BUF2)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a buffer which stores a reference to an external array or the array of an external buffer into
a static field.
 If unchecked changes to
 the array would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is created by storing a reference to an external array in a static field. This means that any changes to the external array will also be reflected in the static field, potentially compromising security or other important properties.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' triggers the bug by modifying the externally passed array and expecting the modification to be reflected in the static field 'buggyArray' of the 'StaticArrayBug' class, which is not the case.
